description: Componentes del PPI de combustibles is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by URSEA. Serie mensual de los componentes utilizados para la determinación del Precio de Paridad de Importación (PPI) de combustibles en Uruguay. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher URSEA. Its tags are Combustibles líquidos, Componentes, Precios. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
